breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to neglect atmospheric pressure. Instead, it used the standard formula for NPSHa which includes the atmospheric pressure head term (Patm/(ρg)), aligning perfectly with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The agent resolved the issue of mixing pressure types by using the correct, standard formula for NPSHa. This formula is based on absolute pressures (atmospheric pressure head minus suction lift, head loss, and vapor pressure head), which is the correct physical approach and matches the ground truth.
